records.title: 10-Q
records.text: At September 30, 2023, our dollar-based net revenue retention rate declined from the quarter ended June 30, 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: At September 30, 2023, we had 381,892 individual users across 4,368 customers.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the quarters ended September 30, 2023 and 2022, we had revenues totaling $150.7 million and $134.3 million, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •$3.2 million increase in computer software and data center expenses due to higher spend on cloud hosting services as customers continue to migrate to the Google Cloud Platform, as well as an increase in software purchases;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the nine months ended September 30, 2023, cash provided by operations was $84.4 million, resulting from net non-cash expenses of approximately $47.1 million, net income of $34.8 million, and net cash flows provided as a result of changes in operating assets and liabilities of $2.5 million.
